title: fix(plugin-detail): the record page's empty-sections line follows the remembered show-empty-fields choice
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEdwjBmjmPjaieDs6mot1QR)_

Fixes #35166

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页底部那条「地址 · 转化 · N 个空分区 · 展开」空分区行,改为读写读者已记住的「显示空字段」选择(与各分区自己的「显示 N 个空字段」行同一个 `showEmptyFields`,按用户 + 对象存)。默认页与编排页都生效;顺手改正 `RecordDetailView.tsx` 一处过时注释。
- 为什么改:读者选过「显示空字段」,空分区行仍每次折叠;展开后关页即忘,每次进记录都得再点一次。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `plugin-detail` 一个组件 + 一处传参;无宿主偏好存储(未登录、无 bridge)时行为与原来一致(组件自身状态)。注意:展开/收起这条行就是同一个选择,所以会一并展开/收起各分区内的空字段。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/EmptySectionsFold.tsx` 的 `EmptySectionsLine`(`remembered` 一段)→ `DetailView.tsx` 传 `objectName` 一行 → 测试文件末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:登录 console,打开任一有空分区的记录,点空分区行「展开」,刷新页面,预期该行仍是展开(「收起」)状态,换同对象另一条记录也一样。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `EmptySectionsLine` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/EmptySectionsFold.tsx`) takes the page's `objectName` and, under a host record-page preference store (`useRecordPagePreferences`), reads its expanded state from that object's `showEmptyFields` entry and writes an expand or collapse back to it — the same entry and the same local-state fallback `DetailSection` uses (objectstack#25883). With no store or no object name it keeps its own state, as before.
- `DetailView` passes `schema.objectName` to the line. Both page kinds reach the line through this one call site: the synthesized default page (`DefaultRecordPageContext`) and every `record:details` body (`EmptySectionsLineContext`, which hands `ctx.objectName` down as `schema.objectName`).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: the comment that listed the empty-sections line as a default-page-only face now says every `record:details` body draws it.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

One choice, not two: expanding the line sets `showEmptyFields: true`, which also opens each section's own empty fields (sections read the same entry). The card asks for "the same remembered 「显示空字段」 choice"; no new preference key was added.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/EmptySectionsLine.authoredPage-35019.test.tsx` (the line's existing harness), run for both page kinds (authored page; default page via `DefaultRecordPageContext`):

- a remembered `showEmptyFields: true` opens the line and every empty field shows;
- CONTROL: another object's remembered choice leaves the line folded;
- expanding writes `['crm_opportunity', { showEmptyFields: true }]`, survives a remount; collapsing writes `false`, also survives;
- CONTROL: with no host store the line's state is forgotten on unmount.

Ablation (one-shot, not kept): `EmptySectionsFold.tsx` replaced by its `ec227fc7` bytes (`grep -c useRecordPagePreferences` → 0) ⇒ `Tests 4 failed | 13 passed (17)` — exactly the two remembered-true and the two remount cases, both page kinds; the three controls stay green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker count back to 2.

## Acceptance notes

- Follow-up (out of scope per dispatch): `EmptySectionsFold` (the whole-body fold a standalone `detail-view` draws) keeps `revealed` in `useState(false)` and does not read the remembered choice either.
